corpus.note: Queries and expected ids were selected from the live personal corpus and frozen here. The corpus keeps growing and decaying; expectations are never re-derived from live ranks during a run. Re-select a case only when its target is legitimately superseded or deleted.

surfaces.rest: GET /api/memory/search?query=<q>&topK=3 (raw index surface, no reranker, no graph expansion)
surfaces.auto: GET /api/recall/context?query=<q> (boundary recall; no sessionID so snapshot/topic/goal are inert; live search + FOK outlet)

metricDefinitions.restHit1: an expected id appears at REST rank 1
metricDefinitions.restHit3: an expected id appears in REST top 3
metricDefinitions.autoHit: an expected id appears in the auto-recall #mem- pointers (neighbour lines included: they are injected evidence)
metricDefinitions.falseInjection: a negative entry injects any #mem- pointer at all
metricDefinitions.staleInjection: a must_exclude (superseded) id appears in the auto-recall pointers
metricDefinitions.entrypointAgreement: REST hit@3 equals auto inclusion on positive entries
metricDefinitions.noteBoard: note-board / user-profile / agent-priors blocks are stripped before id parsing; they are must-surface, not related recall
